unit: Fixed Fermat function-field presentation and genuine noncritical Belyi input
fixed_height_unchanged: Fermat.canonicalHeight p = ((N:Real)-3) * Height.logHeight ![u p,v p,1] / degree p (up to the existing definition's parentheses)

iut_identity.note: No independent .git exists under refer/iut. No parent-worktree HEAD is reported as its revision.

fields: generate : Rat(u,v) = top as an IntermediateField Rat K
concrete_model.why_faithful: Transcendence, generation, the actual Fermat equation, and degree N over Rat(u) specify the full Fermat function-field presentation, not an unrelated finite extension or algebraic field. Existence must prove irreducibility; it is not assumed in Definitions.
concrete_model.new_adaptation: Exact degree N over Rat(u) is a new explicit obligation. Genl's Kummer construction alone is not cited as proving that exact degree. An Eisenstein/irreducibility argument for V^N-(1-U^N) over Rat(U) must justify it.

ported_real_carriers.name: Place K
ported_real_carriers.definition: ValuationSubring K with O != top and all rational constants in O

ported_real_carriers.name: QbarPoint K
ported_real_carriers.definition: P : Place K and sigma : ResidueField P ->+* AlgebraicClosure Rat

ported_real_carriers.name: ord M hDVR P f
ported_real_carriers.definition: minus WithZero.log of the normalized DVR maximal-ideal valuation at f

ported_real_carriers.name: ramIdx M hDVR phi P
ported_real_carriers.definition: ord_P(minpoly(residue phi) evaluated at phi) when regular; minus ord_P(phi) at a pole

ported_real_carriers.name: IsBelyi M hDVR phi
ported_real_carriers.definition: Transcendental Rat phi and every place with ramification index >1 is a zero, pole, or value-one place
ported_real_carriers.source: Belyi/CurveField/NoncriticalBasic.lean:92-97; equivalence to natural-index version in NoncriticalBridge.lean:24-45

ported_real_carriers.name: cuspDivisor M hDVR phi hfin
ported_real_carriers.definition: sum of each actual cusp place with coefficient 1, from explicit finite-support proof hfin

ported_real_carriers.name: StrictQ M hDVR phi hfin q
ported_real_carriers.unproved_identification: The number N*(N-3) still needs identification with the true canonical divisor's degree before using this as the source's strict-q height hypothesis.

remaining_precise_edges.name: local_compact_subsequence
remaining_precise_edges.needs: Use pinned Mathlib PadicAlgCl 2 and Complex with all embeddings. Still need the bounded-degree proper-point local compactness theorem; no new algebraic-closure carrier is needed.
remaining_precise_edges.intended_type: For any xs : Nat -> Fermat.Pt N of degree <=d, pass through AffineIdentification to proper QbarPoints; obtain StrictMono s and finite T : Finset (Place M.K), such that any phi with phi,inverse(phi),inverse(phi-1) regular at every P in T has eventually bounded log norms of its nonzero/nonone values at all embeddings into Qbar_2 and Complex.
remaining_precise_edges.consumer: Combine with noncriticalSelection and image-field arithmetic to construct compact Belyi images.

remaining_precise_edges.name: canonical_and_cusp_height_identification
remaining_precise_edges.needs: A true canonical divisor and divHeight built from arithmetic coordinates, not an arbitrary function with axioms. The fixed Fermat height is unchanged.
remaining_precise_edges.intended_type: Identify degree(K_F)=N*(N-3), omega_F with O_F(N-3), and its Weil height with canonicalHeight up to one uniform bounded discrepancy. For actual E=cuspDivisor(phi), identify h_K+h_E with tripod height of phi up to one uniform bounded discrepancy.
remaining_precise_edges.source: Belyi.CurveField.Canonical; Belyi.CurveField.BelyiRelation; Heights.Curve height construction; Genl/Curves/BelyiDescent.lean:215-237

remaining_precise_edges.name: strict_q_height_bound
remaining_precise_edges.needs: The genuine Weil height of the actual cusp divisor and the canonical identification above; no free Pt->Real height field
remaining_precise_edges.intended_type: forall q, StrictQ M hDVR phi hfin q -> exists C, forall affine p, divHeight(cuspDivisor phi)(p) <= q*canonicalHeight(A.equiv p)+C
remaining_precise_edges.consumer: Contradiction with delta=epsilon/(1+q*(1+epsilon)); equality at the degree ratio is not enough.

remaining_precise_edges.name: different_conductor_and_cusp_height_bounds
remaining_precise_edges.needs: Actual coordinate ring of complement of cuspDivisor(phi), its finite generator set, and actual normalized logCondOf; no free conductor function
remaining_precise_edges.intended_type: Image logDiff+logCond <= Fermat logDiff + logCond_E + C1 and logCond_E <= divHeight E + C2, uniformly in admissible points
